many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

from collections import Counter
T=np.array(G['Test input'])
Din=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); Dout=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])
Q=[4,3,2,1,5,7,2,4,6]

def f(I):
    h,w=I.shape; O=I.copy()
    res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        cs=[(int(x),j) for j,x in enumerate(I[i]) if x!=0]
        # phase candidates: s such that cycle matches all known cells
        cands=[s for s in range(9) if all(Q[(j-s)%9]==x for x,j in cs)]
        if not cands:
            res.append(list(O[i]))
            continue
        s=min(cands)
        res.append([Q[(j-s)%9] for j in range(w)])
    return np.array(res,dtype=int)

F=f(Din)
print("demo match:", np.all(F==Dout))
out=F(Dout.tolist())
print(np.all(out==Dout))
res=f(T)
